definitions.explanation: Adding a decorative or functional border or edge to something. Used for sewing, crafts, design, and also figuratively for visual outlining effects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{縁取|ふちど}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{付|つ}いた→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦ハンカチ→ハンカチ：02937_hankachi⟧。
⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{縁取|ふちど}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Outlining the text in white makes it easier to read.

notes:
{縁取|ふちど}り means adding a decorative border or outline to something. From {縁|ふち} (edge) + ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧ (doing).

DOMAINS:
- Sewing/crafts: adding decorative trim along edges of fabric
- Graphic design: adding an outline around text or shapes
- Ceramics/tableware: decorative borders on plates, cups, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁取|ふちど}り: gold edging
- {縁取|ふちど}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to add edging/trim
- {縁取|ふちど}り⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧: outlined text
- ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{縁取|ふちど}り: red trimming

FORMS:
{縁取|ふちど}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ or {縁取|ふちど}る can both be used, though the ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ form is more common.
